evidence:
Execution model: test.sh (task lines 104-113, 203-227; identical to template) starts ONE app on one DB and runs suite 'gates' then suite 'scored' with `rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1`. Pinned harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (tests/Dockerfile:31) discovers dimensions with `sorted(d for d in tests_path.iterdir() ...)` (runner.py:199-204) and creates tasks in that order under one asyncio.Semaphore(1) (runner.py:321-332; reward.py:25-30, 213), so order is gates: constraints -> render; scored: functional -> polish -> visual, serially. Earlier dimensions therefore mutate the shared app before later ones.

State-relative wording is present everywhere a later dimension touches shared state: app_context.md:27-31 'Other reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages; never rely on a starting count'; functional prompt.md:15 'Earlier reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages. Use your own new jobs and cards ... never rely on starting counts'; polish prompt.md:14 'Use your own new job and cards ... never rely on another review's records ... If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own'; visual prompt.md:14 read-only review of 'a job with cards in several stages (a seeded job is fine)'. Functional counts are relative: T 'counts read relative to their values before you act' (prompt.md:39), U Mei's count 'computed from the observed sequence' (prompt.md:41), hro_unread_counts 'rises by exactly two', hro_thread_latest/earlier use 'most recent 30' and 'until none remain' rather than the 120 seed count, hro_restart compares against values recorded in D. S/T fallbacks handle collisions ('if that address is already on J2, open a new job J3').

The one absolute seed-derived assertion is functional Z / hro_unread_counts: 'Lena Fischer starts with 1 unread' (prompt.md:25, judge.toml:335). Verified seed: APP-301 (Lena, Product Designer) has 3 messages [REC3, CAN3, REC3] and reads USR-CAN3/APP-301 read_count=2 -> 1 unread. Only constraints and render run before functional; render forbids it ('Do not create, move or send anything, and do not open any conversation', render prompt.md:9) and constraints forbids messaging ('Do not move, reject or message anything here', constraints prompt.md:9); neither signs in as Lena. Within functional, Z is 'Before anything else' and forbids Lena sign-in before K. Polish (which sends Rafael messages in an unspecified 'a conversation' for hro_pol_failed_send/session_resume and could hit Lena's thread) runs after functional, so it cannot disturb Z. Visual is read-only and assumes nothing seed-exact; its 'seeded job is fine' tolerates functional's possible fallback moves on seeded APP-201 (K fallback). Polish's 'both boxes are empty' for Mei relies only on Mei-owned drafts, and no earlier dimension asks Mei to leave an unsent draft (functional Mei only sends). Restart in functional D precedes polish/visual; they assume persisted, not pristine, state.

Counterexample attempts: (1) broken app that could pass — an app that reseeds on every start would make later dimensions see pristine data but is caught by hro_restart's 'starting data is not loaded again'; nothing in this row rewards it. (2) conforming app that could fail — a correct app whose Lena count moved because an earlier dimension wrote to her thread; not reachable under the pinned serial sorted order and the gates' explicit prohibitions. No dimension was found that assumes a pristine seed after another dimension's mutations.
